name: Nanaha no Ken Kunoichi In no Shou
original_name: 七巴の剣 くのいち 淫の章
source:
Main character needs to perform a ritual to have sex with a woman in sacred mountains. This ritual is held each 100 years, and the time for it approaches. He goes in the trip with a small company of people, but they get attacked and obstructed on their way by female kunoichi band. What awaits him?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-july-2003-komorebi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公必须在神圣的山中举行一场仪式，与一名女性发生关系。这场仪式每100年举行一次，时候已经临近。他与一小队人踏上旅途，却在路上遭到一伙女忍者袭击和阻挠。等待他的会是什么？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-july-2003-komorebi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
